description:
The Little Cloud Afraid of Thunder: Finding Inner Bravery! — Cloudee shook with fear whenever thunder rumbled! How did a tiny raindrop teach him how to be brave?
Kids science answer for "overcoming fear story for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Being brave doesn't mean you never feel scared. Bravery is feeling butterflies in your tummy and taking a deep breath anyway.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
